filesystem-rw.description: Read-write access to code, specs, skills, prompts, tests and ADRs. Excludes business documentation and retrieval corpus.

filesystem-docs.description: Read-only access to NovaTech business documentation. Source of truth — no writes allowed.

filesystem-corpus.description: Read-only access to RAG retrieval corpus chunks. Used to simulate Azure AI Search locally.

git.description: Git history, diff and branch inspection. Local repository only — no remote push operations.

memory.description: Persistent knowledge graph for domain decisions, ubiquitous language and architectural choices.

everything.description: MCP primitives exploration only. No project data access.
